prompt: Classify the sentiment of this sentence as positive, negative or neutral. Answer with one word. Sentence: 'The new portal saves me an hour every week.'
What is the capital of Portugal? Answer with one word.
Give the date in this sentence in YYYY-MM-DD format and nothing else: 'The committee meets on 14 March 2027.'
Translate the English word 'library' into Spanish. Answer with one word.
How many days are there in a leap year? Answer with a number only.
Which of these is a fruit: carrot, apple, potato? Answer with one word.
Give the usual acronym for 'Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development'. Answer with the acronym only.
Is 17 a prime number? Answer yes or no.
Label this help-desk request as IT, HR or Finance. Answer with the label only. Request: 'My laptop will not connect to the Wi-Fi.'
What is 15% of 200? Answer with a number only.
Give the plural of the English noun 'analysis'. Answer with one word.
Name the ocean between Europe and North America. Answer with one word.

A department has an annual AI budget of 12000 EUR. It spends 850 EUR per month for the first 5 months, then 1300 EUR per month for the other 7 months. By how much does it exceed or stay under the budget? Answer with a signed number: positive if over budget, negative if under. Number only.

Extract these fields from the note and return only a JSON object with keys 'meeting', 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD), 'participants' (an integer) and 'decision'. Note: 'At the Digital Governance Board on 3 February 2027, the nine members agreed to extend the pilot by six months.'

Three teams used these amounts of tokens last month: Research 4.2 million, Legal 0.9 million, Communications 2.6 million. The price is 3 EUR per million tokens. Which team costs the most, and what is the total cost of the three teams in EUR? Answer in the form 'TEAM; TOTAL', for example 'Legal; 10.5'.
Anna is older than Ben. Ben is older than Chloe. Chloe is older than David. Who is the second youngest? Reason it through, then give only the name as your final answer on the last line.
List exactly three risks of deploying a chatbot for staff. Use exactly three lines, each starting with '- ', and write nothing else.

A team produces 1200 pages per month. With an AI tool its output rises by 25 percent, but 10 percent of the pages produced with the tool must be discarded. How many usable pages per month does the team produce with the tool? Number only.
A contract starts on 15 January 2027 and lasts 18 months, ending the day before the same day of the month 18 months later. On what date does it end? Answer in YYYY-MM-DD format only.

Apply these retention rules: board minutes are kept permanently; contracts 7 years; files of unsuccessful job candidates 1 year; email not filed as a record 3 years. Records: (a) a signed cleaning-services contract, (b) the minutes of the March board meeting, (c) the application of a rejected candidate. Answer in the form 'a=..., b=..., c=...' using 'permanent', '7 years', '1 year' or '3 years'.

Summarise this in one sentence of at most 20 words that includes the word 'pilot': 'The Institute tested an AI assistant with 40 staff for three months as a pilot. Users saved on average two hours per week but reported errors in citations. The assistant will be extended to 200 staff once the citation checker is fixed.'

Country A has a GDP of 500 billion and spends 2.1 percent of it on R&D. Country B has a GDP of 800 billion and spends 1.5 percent. Which country spends more on R&D in absolute terms, and by how many billion? Answer in the form 'A; 1.5'.

Decide whether each request needs a simple or a complex model and return only a JSON object mapping the id to 'simple' or 'complex'. r1: 'What time is it in Tokyo?' r2: 'Draft a two-page strategy comparing three cloud providers on cost, security and lock-in.'
What does this Python expression return: sum(x * x for x in range(1, 5))? Answer with a number only.
